description: List controls scoped to the organization with status, basis, target maturity, materiality, procedure and last validation. Filter by scope, domain, framework, team, basis, material. Paginated.

accountable_owner_type.description: Filter by the accountable team's primary owner: 'internal' or 'external_contractor'

basis.description: Filter by obligation basis: 'mcr', 'dsr', or 'unclassified' (no classified framework and no override). Each row carries obligation_basis, basis_source (override | framework) and basis_override_reason

framework.description: Framework slug (e.g., 'nist-800-53') to filter mapped controls

function_id.description: Filter to controls assigned to any team aligned to this function — obtain from scf_list_functions

material.description: Filter by materiality: true for material controls (catalogue weighting 10, or an admin override), false for the rest. Rows carry material, material_source (control | weighting) and material_reason

my_teams.description: Filter to controls assigned to any team the caller belongs to; intersects with team_id rather than overriding it. 'The caller' is the API key's identity; on a self-hosted instance that is a service account on no team, so this returns nothing — use team_id instead.

offset.description: Pagination offset — number of results to skip (default 0)

search.description: Free-text filter applied to control ID, name, or description

sort.description: Order: 'scf_id' (default), or 'weighting' — material controls first, then catalogue weighting highest first, then scf_id. Rows also carry target_maturity, target_source (control | domain), target_maturity_reason, procedure_document_id, procedure_document_status, last_validated_at, last_validated_by and last_validation_note

team_id.description: Filter to controls this team is assigned to, accountable or consulted — obtain from scf_list_teams

name: scf_list_scoped_controls
